# Three planning examples merged after the rollout get the ThemeSwitcher

## Context

#21704's closeout review ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21704#issuecomment-7064061700)) checked the published catalog on `dev` `2c0ac855f9`. All 128 records have a theme control or need none. Three planning examples merged today after #21755's last head, and #21613 publishes them at Sunday's catalog lock: `gantt/taskEditor` (#21732), `gantt/taskColumns` (#21701) and `scheduler/eventEditor` (#21731). None of them has a switcher.

## The Problem

Each of the three reads `?theme=` at start in its `app.mjs` and offers no theme control on the page. That is the URL-only state #21704 exists to end. The planning rollout (#21706, PR #21755) could not include them, because they reached `dev` after its last head.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` (`src/button/ThemeSwitcher.mjs`, PR #21716) shows a dropdown when three or more themes are configured.
- The rollout's shape: an example imports it and adds `{module: ThemeSwitcher}` as the last item of its header toolbar, as in `examples/gantt/basic/Viewport.mjs`. Each of the three already has a header `Toolbar` in its `Viewport.mjs`.
- Coverage: `test/playwright/e2e/timeline/PlanningThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs` loads every path in `ALL_PLANNING_EXAMPLES` at both sizes. It asserts that the switcher is visible and reachable without toolbar overflow. Switching itself is the component's behaviour, and the spec's `INTERACTIVE_EXAMPLES` cover it.

## The Fix

Add the switcher to the three header toolbars in the rollout's shape, and add the three paths to `ALL_PLANNING_EXAMPLES`. Each example's own `app.mjs` start-theme logic stays; the switcher changes the theme from there.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: each of the three examples shows the ThemeSwitcher in its header, visible and reachable without toolbar overflow at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, asserted through `PlanningThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs` › `ALL_PLANNING_EXAMPLES`.
- [ ] AC-2: each example's own e2e spec stays green (`TaskEditorNL`, `TaskColumnsNL`, the scheduler event editor's).
- [ ] AC-3: the PR shows each header with the switcher, before and after, at 1440 × 900 in the dark theme.

## Out of Scope

- The start-theme resolver copies in examples' `app.mjs` (#21761).
- Any example not in the catalog and not queued by #21613.
